name: iD Tech Camps held at MIT
description_short: Week long tech day camps for ages 7 to 17 held on the MIT campus in Cambridge, 9:00 to 4:30, in coding, game design, robotics and 3D printing, with recreation breaks on Briggs Field. Teens 13 to 18 can take two week overnight iD Tech Academies in the dorms.
special_needs_notes: Students of all abilities are welcome; families should contact iD Tech at least three weeks before camp to plan accommodations.
refund_policy_summary: Unlimited free changes up to 28 days before the session. Full refund for cancellations before March 1; after March 1 and at least 28 days before the session, a refund less additional fees.
notes: Camps run June 20 to August 13, 2027. Day camps start at $1,578 a week; two week overnight Teen Academies start at $5,299. Camps are run by iD Tech and are not affiliated with MIT. The nearest weeklong overnight camp for ages 10 and up is at Bentley University.
